introHtml: Hanes fanny packs combine the trusted quality of a heritage apparel brand with the hands-free convenience of a waist pack. Ideal for trade show attendees, event staff, or promotional giveaways, these lightweight nylon packs feature an adjustable belt and multiple zippered compartments. Screen printing or embroidery on the front panel ensures your logo stays visible. Choose Hanes when you need a reliable, affordable fanny pack that recipients will actually use.
